Delete your Dhobify account

This page explains how you can request deletion of your Dhobify account and data associated with your account. Dhobify is published on Google Play under the name Dhobify.

How to delete your account (in the app)

The primary way to delete your account is inside the Dhobify mobile app. Follow these steps:

  1. Open the Dhobify app on your device.
  2. Go to Profile or Account (whichever label your app version shows).
  3. Tap Delete account (or similarly named option).
  4. Read the on-screen warning carefully.
  5. Confirm when prompted to complete the request.

After you confirm, deletion is permanent. You will not be able to restore the same account from the app.

What data is deleted

When account deletion completes successfully in our systems, we remove or clear:

  • Your customer profile (for example, phone, name, and account settings stored with your account).
  • Your sign-in identity (removed when deletion completes successfully).
  • Saved addresses.
  • Active carts and cart line items.
  • Push notification device registrations.
  • Personal delivery details stored on past orders (for example, saved address snapshots and customer notes on those orders).
  • Reviews and coupon redemptions linked to your user — cleared or delinked as part of account deletion.

If any category of personal data is not fully removed, it is listed under What may be kept or anonymized below.

What may be kept or anonymized

Some records are kept for legal or operational reasons, or sit outside the app’s account-deletion flow. These may include:

  • Commercial and audit records: order, item, bill, and status-history data without the cleared personal fields (for example, amounts, fees, and operational status), where we need them to run the business and meet record-keeping expectations.
  • Tax, accounting, and disputes: We retain business and tax records for at least six years from the end of the relevant assessment year where the Income Tax Act, 1961 applies, and longer while any assessment, appeal, or dispute remains open. We may retain order, billing, and operational records (including amounts, fees, and status history) in non-identifying or aggregated form where needed for legal, tax, audit, or dispute handling, consistent with this retention approach.
  • Provider and platform logs: SMS providers, hosting and database services (including Supabase), and similar infrastructure logs are not deleted by this app’s account deletion alone.
  • Third-party services: Third-party services described in our Privacy Policy may retain technical or usage data under their own policies; account deletion in the app does not delete vendor-side copies.
  • Deletion edge case: if sign-in removal does not complete in a single pass, your auth record might persist briefly until we resolve it — contact support using the details below if you believe your account was not fully removed.

Retention and processing time

Deletion timing: Account deletion is applied promptly after you confirm in the app.

Database backups: Production data is on Supabase. Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) is not enabled. Scheduled backups run daily (around midnight in the project region). Deleted rows may still exist in automatic backups for up to 7 days, after which they age out with the backup rotation for our current plan. If a backup were restored, data could reappear as of that backup time; we would reconcile or re-run deletion as needed.

If you cannot access the app

Alternative contact (use if you cannot complete deletion in the app):

  • Email: support@dhobify.in
  • Phone: +91 63772 29112

To help us verify your identity before we process a deletion request, please send your registered phone number and full name as they appear on your Dhobify account. We may ask for additional information if needed to confirm the request.
